name: MSP430X Lens
description: MSP430X architecture and raw firmware loader.
longdescription: Adds MSP430X instruction decoding, disassembly, LLIL lifting, and a mapped raw-firmware BinaryView. Raw firmware is the primary workflow, with ELF files supported as well. MSP430F5438 and MSP430F5438A are the currently tested device profiles. The loader seeds memory regions, interrupt vectors, conservative code islands, and TI header labels so firmware is ready for analysis.
